lines.text: Eli's sons were wicked, and the priest's servant plunged a three-pronged fork into the pot and the priest claimed whatever came up.
The servant demanded raw meat for the priest, and the sin of these young men was severe because they treated the LORD's offering with contempt.
Each year Hannah brought Samuel a little sash, and the LORD gave her three sons and two daughters.
A man of God told Eli the LORD had selected his father out of all the tribes to be priest, yet Eli honored his sons more.
The sign for Eli was that his two sons Hophni and Phinehas would both be taken captive on the same day.
